context: Hi there! How are you today?
I'm great, how are you?
Am alright. Except for you know... Um, I am here to help you with a movie trailer.
I hear ya. I have zero idea what movies are out right now.
Oh alright. You're in good hands. What genres do you like? Comedy, scifi, action, romance  :-) ?
All of them. I'm not particularly picky with genre.
Okay thats fine. What was the last movie you watched, if you can remember?
Serial Mom. It was such a cheesy comedy thriller.
Okay. So lets indulge in comedy
Sounds good.
Do you know Kevin hart? He is super hilarious.
Yes! Philly native like me!
Lol okay. Have you seen Night School?
I have not. It's on my never-ending list of movies to watch though
Never-ending! I thought I was the only one with that list. Anyway since you already have it, how about the wedding ringer?
LOL good to find a kindred movie spirit. What's that movie about
It's about a socially awkward guy that hires company owner that provides best men for grooms in need.. It has 2 awards and 4 nominations.
Who is in it?
Kevin Hart, Josh Gad, Affion Crockett and Kaley Cuoco
Ooh, sold!
Do you like the recommendation? Heck I have to add it to my list as well.
Absolutely! And now that there's seemingly all the time in the world to watch movies, I will have to watch both of them this week! Thank you!
You happiness is my mission. Would you like to watch the trailer?
For sure

context.content: Hi there! What kind of movies do you usually enjoy?
Hey! I'm into comedies mostly. Something that can make me laugh and maybe think a bit too.
That sounds great! Have you seen "My Favorite Year" (1982)? It's a delightful comedy about a struggling actor who gets a chance to star in a Broadway production.
"My Favorite Year"? Sounds interesting. Can you tell me more about it? [END]
